name.x-prompt: What should be the name of the entity?

path.description: The path to create the entity files.

skipTests.description: When true, does not create test files.

reducers.description: The reducers file (path) to add the entity reducer to.

module.description: The NgModule (path) to register the reducer in. Without it, the nearest NgModule is used, if the app has one.

flat.description: When true (the default), creates the files in the path directly; when false, creates them in a folder named after the entity.

group.description: When true, puts the actions, model and reducer in actions, models and reducers folders.

feature.description: Set by the feature schematic. It does not change what this schematic generates.
